safety and community

Safe by design, not by accident.

MDT is built for teenagers, so safety isn't a setting. It's part of how everything works, from sign-up to the community.

Community guidelines How reporting works
shield

If something feels wrong,
tell us. We'll listen.

Community guidelines.

Every MDT member agrees to these before joining the community. Breaking them can mean losing access.

Short version: be the kind of person you'd want to learn next to.
  1. Be kind

    Give feedback you'd be happy to receive. Disagree with ideas, not people.

  2. Keep personal details private

    Don't share your address, phone number, school or passwords, or anyone else's.

  3. No bullying, hate or harassment

    Not in posts, comments, messages or projects. Not as a joke either.

  4. Credit other people's work

    Only post work you made, or say clearly where it came from.

  5. Keep it age-appropriate

    Nothing you wouldn't show a younger cousin.

  6. Speak up

    If something feels off, report it. You won't get in trouble for reporting.

What happens when you report something.

  1. You report it

    Tap report on any post, comment, message or profile, and say what's wrong.

  2. A moderator reviews it

    A real person looks at it. Serious reports prioritises the student’s safety and escalate immediately to the designated safeguarding lead and appropriate external authorities or services where required.

  3. We act

    That might mean removing content, a warning, or removing someone from MDT.

  4. We follow up

    We let you know it's been handled. Your report stays confidential.

Parents say yes first

Kept secure

manage_accounts

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your data. Read our privacy policy.

Adults on MDT are checked.

Every tutor goes through a safeguarding check before they can teach, and tutor activity follows the same community guidelines as everyone else.

1. Identity verification.
2. Verification of relevant qualifications, experience or demonstrated expertise.
3. Reference checks where appropriate.
4. Review of previous work or portfolio.
5. Safeguarding declaration and agreement to MDT’s child protection standards.
6. Review and approval of submitted educational content.
7. Signed instructor/content contributor agreement.

emergency

Need help right now?

If you or someone else is in danger, call 112, Nigeria's emergency number. Then tell an adult you trust.

For anything else, write to our safety team at safety@yourdomain.
